SELECT table_name AS "tableName", obj_description( ('"' || table_schema || '"."' || table_name || '"')::regclass, 'pg_class' ) AS "remark" FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_type = 'BASE TABLE' AND table_catalog = current_database()
AND obj_description(('"' || table_schema || '"."' || table_name || '"')::regclass, 'pg_class') LIKE CONCAT('%', REPLACE(#{remark}, '"', ''), '%')
AND obj_description(('"' || table_schema || '"."' || table_name || '"')::regclass, 'pg_class') IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY table_schema, table_name

SELECT a.attname AS "key", -- 字段名 col_description(a.attrelid, a.attnum) AS "value", -- 字段注释 t.typname AS "type" -- 字段类型 FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.oid JOIN pg_type t ON a.atttypid = t.oid -- 关联类型表获取字段类型 WHERE c.relname = #{tableName} -- 表名 AND a.attnum > 0 -- 排除系统字段 AND NOT a.attisdropped -- 排除已删除字段 ORDER BY a.attnum; -- 按字段顺序排列

SELECT pg_attribute.attname AS primaryKey FROM pg_index JOIN pg_class ON pg_index.indrelid = pg_class.oid JOIN pg_attribute ON pg_attribute.attrelid = pg_class.oid AND pg_attribute.attnum = ANY(pg_index.indkey) WHERE pg_class.relname = #{tableName} AND pg_index.indisprimary -- 只查询主键 ORDER BY pg_attribute.attnum -- 按字段顺序排列（针对联合主键）
